headline: 10th grader needs BDT 50 lakh for bone marrow transplant to fight blood cancer
summary: Faratul has been battling blood cancer for seven years, with his family already spending over BDT 2 crore on his treatment. An urgent bone marrow transplant, costing BDT 50 lakh, is now his only hope.
details: Faratul Mahmud Hasan, a 10th-grade student at Motijheel Ideal School and College's Banasree branch, has been battling blood cancer for seven years. His family now faces a critical challenge, as doctors recommend an urgent bone marrow transplant.

The transplant is estimated to cost approximately BDT 50 lakh, a sum his family is struggling to secure. His father, Md. Sadekul Islam, states that they have already spent over BDT 2 crore on Faratul's treatment, leaving them nearly destitute.

Each month, Faratul's ongoing treatment requires several bags of blood and various medications, incurring a monthly expense of around BDT 1 lakh. This continuous financial strain has exhausted the family's resources.

Unable to bear the additional burden of the transplant cost, Faratul's father has issued a heartfelt appeal to affluent and capable members of society for humanitarian assistance. He hopes their support can save his son's life.
Those wishing to help can send contributions to Md. Sadekul Islam's account: Islami Bank, Rampura Branch, Account No: 20502260201251108. Donations can also be made via Nagad and bKash to 01864291327.

headline_marked: [[Fire at Royal Aid Hospital]] in Khilgaon, Dhaka; no casualties reported
headline: Fire at Royal Aid Hospital in Khilgaon, Dhaka; no casualties reported
summary: A fire broke out at Royal Aid Hospital in Khilgaon, Dhaka, originating from the generator room. All admitted patients were safely evacuated, and no casualties were reported.
details: A fire erupted at Royal Aid Hospital, a private facility in Dhaka's Khilgaon area, late on Saturday night. The Fire Service was alerted about the incident around 11 PM.

Two units from the Fire Service promptly responded to the scene and successfully brought the blaze under control. Senior Station In-charge Arifur Islam confirmed that no casualties or injuries occurred.
The fire reportedly originated from the hospital's generator room. All patients admitted to the hospital were immediately and safely evacuated as a precautionary measure.
An investigation is currently underway to determine if there were any shortcomings or negligence on the part of the hospital authorities regarding the incident.
caption:
A fire erupted at Royal Aid Hospital in Khilgaon, Dhaka, late Saturday night, prompting immediate patient evacuation.

A fire erupted at Royal Aid Hospital, a private facility in Dhaka's Khilgaon area, late on Saturday night. The Fire Service was alerted about the incident around 11 PM.

Two units from the Fire Service promptly responded to the scene and successfully brought the blaze under control. Senior Station In-charge Arifur Islam confirmed that no casualties or injuries occurred.

The fire reportedly originated from the hospital's generator room. All patients admitted to the hospital were immediately and safely evacuated as a precautionary measure.

An investigation is currently underway to determine if there were any shortcomings or negligence on the part of the hospital authorities regarding the incident.
